title: Effect of Data Preprocessing Decisions on Sepsis-3 Labels in MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD: A Sensitivity Analysis
zh_title: 预处理决策对 MIMIC-III 与 eICU 中 Sepsis-3 标签的影响
summary: medRxiv 预印本在固定队列上逐一改变 51 种预处理设置，检验仅预处理差异能否解释文献中脓毒症检出率的巨大跨度。
key_points: 固定队列：MIMIC-III 13,388 例、eICU 94,782 例首住 ICU
在五个预处理域构造 51 种设置变体
比较各设置下的 Sepsis-3 检出率差异
reason: 大样本公开数据库系统性敏感性分析，对脓毒症模型可复现性有价值，但为预印本且内部验证
abstract: Objective: Published Sepsis-3 detection rates range from 3.4 % to 65.2 % in MIMIC-III and from 9.8 % to 47.9 % in eICU-CRD. We tested whether data preprocessing decisions alone produce differences of this magnitude when data, cohort and sepsis definition are held fixed. Materials and Methods: Using the MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD databases we developed and applied a configurable pipeline (medalabel) that stepwise maps the databases into the OMOP Common Data Model, standardizes and cleans the data, and preprocesses them to compute Sepsis-3 labels. Each setting of the preprocessing represents one decision of published Sepsis-3 implementations, and settings can be freely combined. On fixed cohorts of first ICU stays (13,388 in MIMIC-III, 94,782 in eICU-CRD), we changed one setting of a reference configuration at a time (51 variants in five preprocessing domains) and compared detection rates and septic stays (Jaccard index) with the reference. We approximately reconstructed six published pipelines and combined the settings with the largest effects in pairs to test whether their effects add up. The time a value is measured can differ from the time it is documented and thus available for automated analysis. Beyond the usual retrospective view based on measurement time, the pipeline optionally combines both time points to simulate a real-time system. Results: The reference configuration labelled 31.5 % of ICU stays in MIMIC-III and 8.2 % in eICU-CRD as septic. Changing a single setting resulted in sepsis detection rates of 15.3-58.6 % in MIMIC-III and 4.6-17.2 % in eICU-CRD. The largest shifts from the reference, all in the same direction in both databases, came from the SOFA baseline, up to +27.1 percentage points (pp) in MIMIC-III and +9.0 pp in eICU-CRD, from disabling imputation (-16.3 and -2.5 pp), the temporal window (+12.6 and +5.3 pp) and aggregation (-10.1 and -0.8 pp); clinician-validated parameter sets had little effect (-4.8 and -1.1 pp). Even variants that changed the rate by less than 2 pp labelled partly different patients, with Jaccard indices as low as 0.67 in MIMIC-III and 0.56 in eICU-CRD (1 = identical septic stays). Reconstructions deviated from the published rates by 2-10 pp. Two settings applied together deviated from the sum of their single effects by 0.9-11.8 pp in MIMIC-III and by up to 4.9 pp in eICU-CRD. Simulating a real-time system lowered the MIMIC-III rate by 5.0 pp and delayed the label in 45 % of the stays that remained septic. Discus
zh_abstract: 【目的】已发表的Sepsis-3检出率在MIMIC-III中范围为3.4%至65.2%，在eICU-CRD中范围为9.8%至47.9%。我们在数据、队列和脓毒症定义保持不变的情况下，检验了仅数据预处理决策是否会产生如此幅度的差异。【材料与方法】使用MIMIC-III和eICU-CRD数据库，我们开发并应用了一个可配置流程（medalabel），该流程逐步将数据库映射到OMOP Common Data Model，标准化和清理数据，并对其进行预处理以计算Sepsis-3标签。预处理的每个设置代表已发表Sepsis-3实现的一项决策，且设置可自由组合。在固定的首次ICU住院队列中（MIMIC-III中13,388例，eICU-CRD中94,782例），我们每次改变参考配置的一个设置（五个预处理域中的51个变体），并将检出率和脓毒症住院（Jaccard指数）与参考配置进行比较。我们近似重建了六个已发表的流程，并将效应最大的设置成对组合，以检验其效应是否相加。一个数值被测量的时间可能不同于其被记录、从而可用于自动化分析的时间。除了基于测量时间的常规回顾性视图外，该流程还可选择合并这两个时间点，以模拟实时系统。【结果】参考配置将MIMIC-III中31.5%的ICU住院和eICU-CRD中8.2%的ICU住院标记为脓毒症。改变单一设置导致MIMIC-III中脓毒症检出率为15.3-58.6%，eICU-CRD中为4.6-17.2%。相对于参考配置的最大偏移（在两个数据库中方向均相同）来自SOFA基线，在MIMIC-III中高达+27.1个百分点（pp），在eICU-CRD中为+9.0 pp；来自禁用插补（-16.3和-2.5 pp）、时间窗（+12.6和+5.3 pp）和聚合（-10.1和-0.8 pp）；临床医生验证的参数集影响很小（-4.8和-1.1 pp）。即使是将检出率改变不足2 pp的变体，也标记了部分不同的患者，MIMIC-III中Jaccard指数低至0.67，eICU-CRD中低至0.56（1 = 完全相同的脓毒症住院）。重建结果与已发表检出率相差2-10 pp。两个设置共同应用时，其偏离各自单一效应之和的程度在MIMIC-III中为0.9-11.8 pp，在eICU-CRD中高达4.9 pp。模拟实时系统使MIMIC-III的检出率降低5.0 pp，并使45%的仍为脓毒症的住院标签延迟。Discus

title: Future-Information Leakage in 30-Day Readmission Prediction: An Empirical Audit and a Calibrated Electronic Health Record Model in Medicare-Insured Adults
zh_title: 30天再入院预测的未来信息泄漏审计
summary: 基于MIMIC-IV约23.7万次住院，审计出院时点可得性并量化未来信息泄漏对性能与结论的扭曲。
key_points: 研究236,906次Medicare保险住院，患病率21.4%
历史特征按原始时间戳重算，剔除全病程特征
仅内部验证，采用XGBoost与患者分组交叉验证
reason: 大样本方法学审计有借鉴价值，但为预印本且仅内部验证
abstract: Objective: To develop and internally validate a calibrated discharge model of 30-day within-system readmission in Medicare-insured adults, and to quantify how a future-information leak and outcome artifacts distorted performance, timing, and subgroup conclusions. Materials and Methods: Retrospective study of 236,906 Medicare-insured MIMIC-IV v3.1 admissions (87,750 patients; prevalence 21.4%). Predictors were audited for discharge-time availability; history features were tested for future information and recomputed from raw timestamps. A consensus gradient-boosted (XGBoost) model was selected inside patient-grouped folds; CIs used patient-cluster bootstrap. Results: A feature documented as a prior 180-day length-of-stay trend used each patient's whole record, including later admissions; removing it and two derived terms lowered test area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from 0.774 to 0.706. The corrected procedure reached an out-of-fold AUROC of 0.7057 (95% CI 0.7016 to 0.7102; primary); the 44-feature model scored 0.7056 on the historically exposed test partition (calibration slope 0.99), above reconstructed LACE and HOSPITAL (both P<.001). A day-1 discrimination peak largely reflected 2,368 probable administrative continuations within 1 hour of discharge; merging these into the preceding stay gave test AUROC 0.698 (0.702 after refitting). The White minus Black AUROC difference was 0.003 (95% CI -0.018 to 0.024); specificity was lower for Black patients (0.61 vs 0.69). Discussion: Documentation audits and patient-grouped validation missed a leak that inflated discrimination and created spurious subgroup and calendar-period differences; simple empirical checks found it. Conclusion: Empirical leakage checks should accompany availability audits. The corrected model is calibrated, moderately discriminating, and needs external validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract:
【目的】开发并在内部验证一个校准的30天系统内再入院出院模型，用于参加 Medicare 保险的成人，并量化未来信息泄漏和结局伪差如何扭曲性能、时间及亚组结论。
【材料与方法】对236,906条 MIMIC-IV v3.1 中参加 Medicare 保险的住院记录（87,750名患者；患病率21.4%）进行回顾性研究。对预测变量进行出院时可用性审计；对病史特征检验未来信息，并从原始时间戳重新计算。在按患者分组的折内选择共识梯度提升（XGBoost）模型；置信区间使用患者簇自助法。
【结果】一个被记录为先前的180天住院时长趋势的特征使用了每位患者的整个记录，包括后续住院；移除该特征和两个派生项后，测试集受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）从0.774降至0.706。校正后的流程达到折外 AUROC 0.7057（95% CI 0.7016至0.7102；主要结果）；44特征模型在历史暴露的测试分区上得分为0.7056（校准斜率0.99），高于重建的 LACE 和 HOSPITAL（均 P<.001）。第1天区分度峰值在很大程度上反映了出院1小时内2,368例可能的行政性连续住院；将这些合并到前一次住院后，测试 AUROC 为0.698（重新拟合后为0.702）。白人减黑人的 AUROC 差异为0.003（95% CI -0.018至0.024）；黑人患者的特异度较低（0.61 对 0.69）。
【讨论】记录审计和按患者分组验证漏掉了一个泄漏，该泄漏抬高了区分度并产生了虚假的亚组和日历时期差异；简单的经验性检查发现了它。
【结论】经验性泄漏检查应与可用性审计同时进行。校正后的模型已校准、具有中等区分度，在临床使用前需要外部验证。

title: Implementing Artificial Intelligence in Daily Clinical Practice, from Voice Dictation to Operating Room Organization: A Targeted Narrative Review with Hysteroscopy as a Clinical Exemplar.
zh_title: AI进入日常临床实践：以宫腔镜为例的叙述性综述
summary: （据摘要）叙述性综述梳理从语音听写、环境记录到手术室调度等AI落地环节，以宫腔镜为例区分图像级与患者级证据。
key_points: 覆盖语音记录、决策支持与手术室运营
以宫腔镜为从技术性能到临床效用范例
采用区分内部与独立验证的评估框架
reason: 同行评审叙述性综述，关注落地与证据分级；综述类封顶6分，故取5
abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is entering routine care through documentation tools, decision support, and hospital operations. The central question is whether these systems improve clinical work and patient care once embedded in routine workflows, not only whether they perform well on test data. This targeted narrative review follows AI from voice dictation and ambient documentation to operating room (OR) organization, using hysteroscopy as a clinical exemplar of the transition from technical performance to clinical utility. Evidence identified through targeted searches completed on 6 September 2026 was appraised with a framework that distinguishes image-level from patient-level results, internal from independent validation, and discrimination from clinical utility. Randomized trials and multisite observational data show modest, product-dependent benefits of clinician-reviewed ambient documentation; inaccuracies persist. Evidence for patient-message drafting derives from ratings of responses to public-forum questions and supports only bounded, supervised feasibility testing. In hysteroscopy, selected models discriminate well in narrowly defined tasks, but most studies are retrospective, image-level, or internally validated, and patient-level errors in high-risk categories are seldom reported. Reported gains in OR scheduling come largely from simulation. Safe implementation requires a defined clinical need, baseline measurement, subgroup-aware local validation, accountable review, and predefined criteria for expansion or withdrawal.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 人工智能（AI）正通过文档工具、决策支持和医院运营进入常规诊疗。核心问题在于这些系统在嵌入常规工作流程后是否能改善临床工作和患者照护，而不仅仅是它们在测试数据上表现良好。本针对性叙述性综述追踪AI从语音听写和环境文档到手术室（OR）组织的应用，并以宫腔镜作为从技术性能向临床效用转变的临床范例。通过截至2026年9月6日完成的针对性检索所识别的证据，采用一个区分图像层面与患者层面结果、内部验证与独立验证、区分能力与临床效用的框架进行评价。随机试验和多中心观察数据显示，由临床医生审核的环境文档具有适度且因产品而异的获益；不准确之处仍然存在。患者信息起草的证据来源于对公共论坛问题回答的评分，仅支持有范围限制的、受监督的可行性测试。在宫腔镜中，选定模型在狭义定义任务中区分能力良好，但大多数研究为回顾性、图像层面或内部验证，且高风险类别中的患者层面错误很少被报告。所报告的手术室排程改善主要来自模拟。安全实施需要有明确的临床需求、基线测量、考虑亚组的本地验证、可问责的审核，以及预先设定的扩展或退出标准。

title: Current Applications of Artificial Intelligence in Surgical Planning for Craniosynostosis: A Scoping Review.
zh_title: AI在颅缝早闭手术规划中的应用：范围综述
summary: 范围综述纳入11项儿科颅缝早闭研究，梳理AI在严重度评分、表型分类、术前模拟与预后预测中的应用。
key_points: 纳入11项研究，方法含无监督学习、CNN、有限元模型、VAE
应用覆盖颅骨严重度评分、表型分类与术前模拟
AI指标与专家评估高度相关，可支持个体化规划
reason: 范围综述仅11项研究，属综述档上限内偏低，证据以方法学汇总为主
abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] Craniosynostosis, the premature fusion of cranial sutures, can cause abnormal skull shapes, neurological issues and aesthetic concerns. Surgical correction is standard, but planning is complex and operator-dependent. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers the potential to enhance diagnosis, optimise planning and predict postoperative outcomes. A scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidelines identified 11 studies involving paediatric patients with craniosynostosis. AI methods included unsupervised machine learning, convolutional neural networks, finite element models and variational autoencoders. Applications encompassed cranial severity scoring, phenotype classification, preoperative surgical simulation, intraoperative guidance and outcome prediction. AI-derived metrics correlated strongly with expert assessments, facilitated patient-specific planning and predicted postoperative aesthetics. AI is a transformative adjunct in craniosynostosis surgery. Clinically, it improves diagnostic accuracy, supports personalised surgical planning and guides intraoperative decision-making. Some studies show AI can contribute to better functional and aesthetic outcomes, showing great promise in the paediatric surgical field. Although AI does not replace clinical expertise, it enhances precision and reproducibility. Future research should prioritise prospective validation, integration into surgical workflows and development of interpretable, surgeon-friendly AI tools to maximise clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] 颅缝早闭是指颅缝过早融合，可导致颅骨形状异常、神经学问题和美学顾虑。手术矫正是标准治疗，但规划复杂且依赖操作者。人工智能（AI）有望增强诊断、优化规划并预测术后结局。一项遵循PRISMA-ScR指南的范围综述识别出11项涉及颅缝早闭儿科患者的研究。AI方法包括无监督机器学习、卷积神经网络、有限元模型和变分自编码器。应用涵盖颅骨严重程度评分、表型分类、术前手术模拟、术中引导和结局预测。AI得出的指标与专家评估高度相关，促进了患者特异性规划，并预测了术后美学。AI是颅缝早闭手术中的变革性辅助手段。在临床上，它提高诊断准确性、支持个性化手术规划并指导术中决策。一些研究显示AI可有助于改善功能和美学结局，在儿科外科领域展现出巨大前景。尽管AI不能替代临床专业知识，但它增强了精确性和可重复性。未来研究应优先开展前瞻性验证、整合到手术工作流程中，并开发可解释、外科医生友好的AI工具，以最大化临床获益。

title: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Innovative Low-cost Skin Testing Model to Accelerate Person-centered TB Prevention Services in Tanzania, Mozambique and Uganda
zh_title: AI 辅助低成本皮肤试验加速结核预防服务：三国干预试验
summary: 坦桑尼亚、莫桑比克和乌干达登记一项 1804 人干预试验，评估含 AI 辅助判读的床旁结核感染检测与预防治疗衔接模式。
key_points: 三国多中心干预性试验，计划入组 1804 人
评估 AI 辅助判读皮肤试验的可接受性与诊断性能
目前刚注册、尚未招募，无结果
reason: 多国前瞻性干预设计与较大样本量，但仅注册无结果，证据尚缺，属值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: KNCV Tuberculosis Foundation; conditions: Tuberculosis Infection, Latent, Tuberculosis Prevention; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1804; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The Artificial Intelligence Assisted Innovative Low-cost Skin Testing Model to Accelerate Person-centered TB Prevention Services in Tanzania, Mozambique and Uganda (TEST4TPT) project will evaluate a person-centered approach to improve access to tuberculosis infection (TBI) testing and linkage to tuberculosis preventive treatment (TPT) in Mozambique, Tanzania, and Uganda. The project will generate evidence on the feasibility, acceptability, clinical utility, diagnostic and operational performance, and implementation of a novel point-of-care TBI testing approach, including home- or community-based testing and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted reading. By bringing testing closer to people at increased risk of tuberculosis (TB), TEST4TPT aims to reduce barriers to care, support timely TPT initiation, and contribute to improved completion of preventive treatment. The overall goal of TEST4TPT is to evaluate an integrated, home-based approach to TBI testing using SIILTIBCY (an authorized diagnostic skin test used to detect TBI), community health worker (CHW)-facilitated support, and AI-assisted result reading, with the aim of improving initiation and completion of TPT among close contacts of people newly diagnosed with pulmonary TB disease.
zh_abstract: 【新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：KNCV Tuberculosis Foundation；疾病：结核感染，潜伏（Tuberculosis Infection, Latent）、结核病预防（Tuberculosis Prevention）；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：1804；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING】人工智能辅助的创新低成本皮肤检测模型以加速坦桑尼亚、莫桑比克和乌干达以人为本的结核病预防服务（TEST4TPT）项目将评估一种以人为本的方法，以改善莫桑比克、坦桑尼亚和乌干达的结核感染（TBI）检测可及性及其与结核病预防性治疗（TPT）的衔接。该项目将生成关于一种新型即时（point-of-care）TBI检测方法的可行性、可接受性、临床效用、诊断和操作性能及实施情况的证据，包括家庭或社区检测以及人工智能（AI）辅助判读。通过将检测带到结核病（TB）风险增加的人群更近处，TEST4TPT旨在减少照护障碍、支持及时启动TPT，并促进提高预防性治疗的完成率。TEST4TPT的总体目标是评估一种整合的、以家庭为基础的TBI检测方法，使用SIILTIBCY（一种获授权用于检测TBI的诊断性皮肤试验）、社区卫生工作者（CHW）协助支持和AI辅助结果判读，旨在改善新诊断肺结核病患者密切接触者中TPT的启动和完成。

title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Stroke Registry Research: Current Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions.
zh_title: AI在卒中登记研究中的应用：进展、挑战与方向
summary: 叙述性综述梳理卒中登记研究流程中的困难，并讨论AI与大语言模型可提供的支持。
key_points: 聚焦登记研究从选题到成稿的各环节挑战
以大语言模型近年的进展为主要讨论对象
结合日本卒中数据库经验，属叙述性综述
reason: 叙述性综述，无新数据或验证，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of neuroendovascular therapy] Registry-based studies provide real-world evidence that can support clinical decision-making, improve the quality of care, and advance understanding of disease. However, conducting registry-based studies requires substantial time and effort throughout the research workflow, including identifying clinical questions and gaps in existing knowledge, planning studies, developing protocols, collecting and analyzing data, and preparing manuscripts. This narrative review examines the challenges encountered in registry-based studies and discusses how artificial intelligence (AI) may help address them, based on evidence from the broader biomedical literature, with particular reference to our work involving the Japan Stroke Data Bank. AI, particularly large language models, which have advanced rapidly in recent years, has the potential to support literature searches, research question generation, and protocol development, although inaccurate outputs and fabricated references remain important concerns. Natural language processing may facilitate the extraction of structured information from electronic health records and reduce the burden of manual data collection. Machine learning approaches can identify complex relationships in large, high-dimensional datasets and may improve prediction, while large language models may assist with the selection of statistical methods, the generation of analytical code, and the interpretation of results. AI may also support manuscript preparation through language editing, drafting, and the creation of tables and figures. In the future, AI may make it technically feasible to automate much of the registry research workflow. Nevertheless, human oversight remains essential to verify accuracy, protect confidential information, and ensure transparency and accountability for research decisions and outputs. AI is reshaping traditional research processes and may facilitate the generation of novel research findings. However, AI should augment rather than replace the scientific and clinical judgment of researchers.
zh_abstract: [Journal of neuroendovascular therapy] 基于登记的研究提供真实世界证据，可支持临床决策、改善医疗质量并增进对疾病的理解。然而，开展基于登记的研究在整个研究流程中需要大量时间和精力，包括识别临床问题与现有知识空白、规划研究、制定方案、收集和分析数据以及准备稿件。本叙述性综述考察基于登记的研究中遇到的挑战，并基于更广泛生物医学文献中的证据讨论人工智能（AI）如何帮助应对这些挑战，特别参考我们涉及日本卒中数据库（Japan Stroke Data Bank）的工作。AI，尤其是近年来快速发展的大语言模型，有潜力支持文献检索、研究问题生成和方案制定，但不准确的输出和捏造的参考文献仍是重要关切。自然语言处理可能促进从电子健康记录中提取结构化信息，并减轻人工数据收集负担。机器学习方法可以识别大型高维数据集中的复杂关系，并可能改善预测，而大语言模型可能协助选择统计方法、生成分析代码和解释结果。AI还可能通过语言编辑、起草以及创建表格和图形来支持稿件准备。未来，AI可能使将大部分登记研究流程自动化在技术上可行。尽管如此，人工监督仍至关重要，以核实准确性、保护机密信息，并确保研究决策和输出的透明性与问责性。AI正在重塑传统研究流程，并可能促进新研究发现的形成。然而，AI应增强而非取代研究者的科学和临床判断。

title: LabARIA: A Multi-Agent System for Integrative Analytics in Clinical Laboratories

abstract: Background Laboratory medicine underpins clinical decision-making across nearly every care setting. Clinical laboratory errors and delays can compromise diagnostic reliability and patient care. However, laboratory quality and operational data are commonly reviewed through separate manual workflows, limiting timely recognition of emerging problems across complementary data sources. Methods We developed and evaluated LabARIA (Laboratory Agentic Reasoning and Integrative Analytics), a multi-agent AI system for coordinated surveillance of specimen workflows, analytical quality control, and laboratory operations. We conducted a single-center retrospective system development and evaluation at NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital/Weill Cornell Medical Center using laboratory data collected from May 1 through June 18, 2026, including 177,480 specimen-panel records, 75,103 internal quality-control (IQC) measurements, 633 proficiency-testing challenges, and 422 recalibration or maintenance actions. Forecasting agents were evaluated using patient-result streams with controlled perturbations, and synthetic staffing and inventory data. We assessed specimen rejection, cancellation, and turnaround-time patterns; warning recall and lead time before documented laboratory actions; assay-specific patient-based real-time quality control (PBRTQC) performance; and exploratory operational forecasting discrimination. Findings LabARIA characterized specimen and workflow patterns across clinical units and time periods, including hemolysis-related potassium rejections in the intensive care unit during early morning hours (49 of 367 tests [13.3%]). For analytical quality monitoring, the IQC agent generated warnings before 407 of 422 recorded QC actions (recall, 0.964 [95% CI, 0.942-0.978]), with a median lead time of 5.40 days (95% CI, 3.75-6.07). PBRTQC agent selected different monitoring strategies across 35 analytes. In a separate analysis, adding PBRTQC increased action recall from 0.964 to 0.993 (95% CI, 0.979-0.998). A dashboard presented tiered alerts for human review, and an accompanying chatbot supported interactive exploration of the summaries. For the operational forecasting module, areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve for 7-day inventory and staffing risk forecasting were 0.800 (95% CI, 0.696-0.881) and 0.877 (95% CI, 0.778-0.950), respectively. Interpretation LabARIA demonstrated the feasibility of coordinating laboratory quality surveillance across heterogen
zh_abstract: 【背景】检验医学支撑着几乎所有照护场景中的临床决策。临床实验室差错和延迟可能损害诊断可靠性和患者照护。然而，实验室质量和运营数据通常通过彼此分离的人工工作流程进行审查，限制了对互补数据来源中新出现问题的及时识别。【方法】我们开发并评估了LabARIA（Laboratory Agentic Reasoning and Integrative Analytics），这是一个多智能体AI系统，用于协调监测标本工作流程、分析质量控制和实验室运营。我们在NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital/Weill Cornell Medical Center开展了一项单中心回顾性系统开发与评估，使用2026年5月1日至6月18日收集的实验室数据，包括177,480条标本检测组合记录、75,103次内部质量控制（IQC）测量、633项能力验证挑战以及422次重新校准或维护操作。预测智能体使用带有受控扰动的患者结果流以及合成人员配置和库存数据进行评估。我们评估了标本拒收、取消和周转时间模式；在有记录的实验室操作之前，警告的召回率和提前时间；检测项目特异的基于患者的实时质量控制（PBRTQC）性能；以及探索性运营预测区分度。【结果】LabARIA刻画了跨临床单元和时间段的标本与工作流程模式，包括清晨时段重症监护病房中溶血相关钾检测拒收（367次检测中的49次[13.3%]）。对于分析质量监测，IQC智能体在422次有记录的质量控制操作中的407次之前生成警告（召回率0.964 [95% CI, 0.942-0.978]），中位提前时间为5.40天（95% CI, 3.75-6.07）。PBRTQC智能体在35种分析物中选择了不同的监测策略。在一项单独分析中，加入PBRTQC使操作召回率从0.964提高到0.993（95% CI, 0.979-0.998）。一个仪表板呈现分级警报供人工审查，配套聊天机器人支持对摘要的交互式探索。对于运营预测模块，7天库存和人员配置风险预测的受试者工作特征曲线下面积分别为0.800（95% CI, 0.696-0.881）和0.877（95% CI, 0.778-0.950）。【解读】LabARIA证明了跨异质……协调实验室质量监测的可行性。

title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
zh_title: 因果约束与不确定性感知的心肺风险预测
summary: 预印本提出CE-Agent两阶段框架，将流行病学证据转为权重约束，结合胸部CT表型做心肺风险预测。

abstract: Routine chest computed tomography (CT) captures pulmonary, cardiac, and vascular phenotypes that jointly stratify lung cancer and cardiovascular disease, the two leading causes of death in lung-screening populations. Yet clinical risk calculators evaluate each disease in isolation and omit CT findings, whereas unconstrained machine learning overfits small hospital cohorts, learns treatment- and illness-confounded risk directions, and conceals uncertainty when patient records are incomplete. Here we present the Causal Envelope Agent (CE-Agent), a two-stage framework that compiles peer-reviewed epidemiological evidence into explicit constraints on risk-factor weights before any outcome is seen, while estimating local baseline risk and newly added CT phenotypes from cohort data. At deployment, closed-form uncertainty propagation accounts for missing clinical or CT inputs within milliseconds per patient, running over two orders of magnitude faster than Monte Carlo sampling and returning calibrated risk intervals that direct chart review and selective imaging to borderline patients. Across 53,452 lung-screening participants from 33 US hospitals and 6,814 multi-ethnic adults, CE-Agent outperforms cardiovascular calculators in lung screening, exceeds the Pooled Cohort Equations on hard atherosclerotic events while correcting their 1.7-fold risk overestimation, and generalizes from a single hospital or CT scanner to external sites while lowering required sample sizes up to fivefold. Applied unchanged to lung cancer, CE-Agent matches established screening models with accurate calibration even when restricted to risk-factor directions alone, and pairing both predictions improves joint cardiopulmonary triage from a single screening visit.
zh_abstract: 常规胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）可捕获肺部、心脏和血管表型，这些表型共同对肺癌和心血管疾病进行分层，而这两者是肺部筛查人群中的两大主要死因。然而，临床风险计算器孤立评估每种疾病并遗漏CT发现，而无约束的机器学习会过拟合小型医院队列、学习受到治疗和疾病混杂的风险方向，并在患者记录不完整时隐藏不确定性。在此，我们提出Causal Envelope Agent（CE-Agent），这是一个两阶段框架，在观察到任何结局之前，将经同行评议的流行病学证据编译为对风险因素权重的显式约束，同时从队列数据估计本地基线风险和新加入的CT表型。在部署时，闭式不确定性传播可在每名患者数毫秒内考虑缺失的临床或CT输入，运行速度比蒙特卡洛采样快两个数量级以上，并返回校准风险区间，将病历审查和选择性影像检查导向临界患者。在来自33家美国医院的53,452名肺部筛查参与者和6,814名多种族成人中，CE-Agent在肺部筛查中优于心血管计算器，在硬性动脉粥样硬化事件上超过汇总队列方程（Pooled Cohort Equations），同时纠正其1.7倍的风险高估，并从单一医院或CT扫描仪推广到外部站点，同时将所需样本量降低最多五倍。原样应用于肺癌时，CE-Agent即使仅限制于风险因素方向，也能以准确校准匹配既有筛查模型；将两种预测配对可改善单次筛查就诊中的心肺联合分诊。

abstract: BackgroundDistributed learning lets hospitals train prediction models jointly without exchanging patient records, but how the benefits of a swarm network change as it grows, and which hospitals gain most, have so far been studied with artificial partitions of single-center databases. We examined network scaling on real hospitals that differ in size, volume and sepsis prevalence. MethodsWe applied the seven-KPI swarm-learning evaluation framework (Swarm Gain, Local Gain, Relative Local Gain, Model Stability Index, Jains index, Data Utility Index and label entropy) to progressive network scaling on the eICU Collaborative Research Database. From 25 hospitals (71,887 ICU stays; sepsis prevalence 16.6%), six hospitals stratified by bed size (two small, two medium, two large; 14,776 stays) formed networks of two, four and six hospitals in all six category-joining orders; four further hospitals served as substitutes in robustness checks. Swarm learning was simulated with the client-controlled workflow of NVIDIA FLARE (federated averaging, 30 rounds, five random seeds). The task was whole-stay sepsis classification from discretized vital-sign, laboratory and medication features with a 1,313-parameter feedforward network, with AUROC as the metric. ResultsNetwork AUROC increased with every addition in every ordering, from 0.734 (small-first), 0.755 (medium-first) and 0.781 (large-first) at two hospitals to 0.804 (SD 0.002) at six. Swarm Gain exceeded 1 at all nine unique transitions (mean 1.042 for 2[->] 4 and 1.020 for 4[->] 6 hospitals). Every hospital had Local Gain below 1; relative improvement over local training ranged from 4.1% for the strongest hospital (local AUROC 0.773) to 29.5% for the weakest (0.621), averaging 25.5% for small and 5.9% for large hospitals. Adding large hospitals gave existing members the largest gain (mean Relative Local Gain +6.2%); adding small hospitals never reduced it. Seed-to-seed variability fell from a coefficient of variation of 2.2% at two hospitals to 0.2% at six. Feature distributions were near-identical across hospitals (Data Utility Index 0.005-0.013), whereas the change in label entropy tracked Swarm Gain (r = 0.74). Substituting alternative medium or large hospitals left network AUROC between 0.790 and 0.805. ConclusionsOn real multi-hospital data, swarm participation improved every hospitals model, most for hospitals with the weakest local models, with no transition in which an addition harmed the network. title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration

abstract: AI-enabled remote patient monitoring is evolving beyond passive data collection toward agentic AI systems that interpret patient states, coordinate care, and initiate action across domestic and clinical settings. This structured scoping review finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged: Most systems remain human led, while stronger decision-action coupling and embodied AI remain largely confined to prototypes and pilots. Healthcare robotics makes the transition from monitoring to action especially visible by translating AI-generated recommendations and decisions into speech, movement, prompting, physical assistance, escalation, and care coordination, making embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight, and governance fundamental design requirements. Further progress requires safe and interoperable care architectures in which intelligent components operate through clinically validated and accountable workflows. We propose agentic robotics as a future direction for supervised systems embedded in the care ecosystem, connecting AI agents and robots with clinicians, caregivers, and patients through auditable workflows that can be interrupted and remain subject to human oversight and explicit AI governance.
zh_abstract: AI赋能的远程患者监测正在超越被动数据收集，向能够解读患者状态、协调照护并在家庭和临床环境中启动行动的代理式AI系统演进。这项结构化范围综述发现，成熟的代理式照护尚未出现：大多数系统仍由人类主导，而更强的决策-行动耦合和具身AI在很大程度上仍局限于原型和试点。医疗保健机器人通过将AI生成的建议和决策转化为语音、运动、提示、身体辅助、升级处置和照护协调，使从监测到行动的转变尤其明显，从而使具身性、临床整合、人类监督和治理成为基本设计要求。进一步进展需要安全且可互操作的照护架构，在其中智能组件通过经临床验证且可问责的工作流程运行。我们提出代理式机器人技术作为未来方向，用于嵌入照护生态系统的受监督系统，通过可审计、可中断且仍受人类监督和明确AI治理约束的工作流程，将AI代理和机器人与临床医生、照护者和患者连接起来。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Alexandria University; conditions: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Type 2 diabetes needs daily self-management, but most of it happens outside the clinic, where patients get little continuous support. Earlier studies of mobile applications and chatbots were mostly short, and few tested whether benefits last after use stops. This randomized controlled trial will test an Arabic-language mobile application with an artificial intelligence chatbot for adults with type 2 diabetes attending outpatient diabetes clinics in Egypt. The application offers diabetes education, reminders, glucose and activity logging, goal setting, prompts that adapt when use declines, a diabetes distress check, and nurse oversight. A total of 120 adults will be randomly assigned equally to usual care plus the application for 8 weeks, or to usual care with an educational leaflet. Outcome assessors will not know group assignment. The main outcome is self-efficacy. Other outcomes are self-care behaviors, medication adherence, disease knowledge, random blood glucose, diabetes distress, and application use, measured at the start, at 8 weeks, and 6 and 12 weeks after the intervention ends. About 20 intervention participants will then be interviewed about their experiences and what helps or hinders continued use, and these findings will be combined with the trial results.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Alexandria University；疾病：2型糖尿病；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：120；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 2型糖尿病需要每日自我管理，但其中大部分发生在诊所之外，患者获得的持续支持很少。先前关于移动应用程序和聊天机器人的研究大多较短，且很少检验停止使用后获益是否持续。这项随机对照试验将测试一款带有AI聊天机器人的阿拉伯语移动应用程序，对象是在埃及糖尿病门诊就诊的2型糖尿病成人。该应用程序提供糖尿病教育、提醒、血糖和活动记录、目标设定、在使用下降时调整的提示、糖尿病痛苦检查以及护士监督。总共120名成人将被随机等额分配到常规照护加该应用程序8周，或常规照护加教育传单。结局评估者将不知道分组。主要结局是自我效能。其他结局是自我照护行为、用药依从性、疾病知识、随机血糖、糖尿病痛苦和应用程序使用情况，在开始时、第8周以及干预结束后第6周和第12周测量。随后将访谈约20名干预组参与者，了解其体验以及哪些因素帮助或阻碍持续使用，这些发现将与试验结果结合。

title: A thorough review on Deep Learning approaches to 2D-to-3D Registration in Medical Imaging
zh_title: 医学影像二维到三维配准的深度学习综述
summary: arXiv 预印本综述系统梳理深度学习用于 2D-to-3D 医学影像配准的流程设计、架构创新与域适应策略。
key_points: 面向术中导航等场景的 2D-3D 配准问题

abstract: 2D-to-3D image registration is a key component for several medical imaging purposes such as intraoperative guidance, enabling the alignment between preoperative 3D volumes and real-time 2D images. While conventional optimisation-based methods often struggle with non-convex objectives, sensitivity to initialisation, and high computational demands, deep learning (DL) has emerged as a promising alternative, offering improved alignment robustness and the potential for real-time performance. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of DL frameworks developed to address the challenges inherent in 2D-to-3D registration. We first outline how core concepts of DL are adapted to the registration problem. We then examine recent methodological advancements from multiple perspectives, including pipeline design, architectural innovations, and domain adaptation strategies. Particular attention is given to quantitative metrics, highlighting how performance is defined and measured across studies. Across the 41 included studies, we find that direct regression is the most common pipeline (23 studies, against 18 iterative ones), that hybrid CNN-attention architectures are gaining ground, and that research remains heavily concentrated on X-ray-to-CT registration. We conclude by identifying the absence of per-case uncertainty estimation and the strong neglect of temporal or sequential modelling as the two methodological gaps most consequential for clinical readiness, and discuss state-space models as a way to add temporal memory within intraoperative latency budgets. Further opportunities lie in more principled domain adaptation and in the integration of foundation models for representation learning.
zh_abstract: 2D到3D图像配准是若干医学成像用途（如术中引导）的关键组成部分，可实现术前3D体数据与实时2D图像之间的对齐。虽然传统的基于优化的方法常常难以应对非凸目标、对初始化敏感以及高计算需求，但深度学习（DL）已成为一种有前景的替代方案，提供更好的对齐稳健性和实时性能潜力。本综述对为应对2D到3D配准固有挑战而开发的DL框架进行了全面分析。我们首先概述DL的核心概念如何适配配准问题。随后，我们从多个视角考察近期方法学进展，包括流程设计、架构创新和域适应策略。特别关注定量指标，强调各研究如何定义和测量性能。在纳入的41项研究中，我们发现直接回归是最常见的流程（23项研究，对比18项迭代方法），混合CNN-注意力架构正在获得更多应用，且研究仍高度集中于X射线到CT配准。我们最后指出，缺乏逐病例不确定性估计以及对时间或序列建模的严重忽视，是对临床就绪度影响最大的两个方法学缺口，并讨论状态空间模型作为一种在术中延迟预算内加入时间记忆的方法。进一步的机会在于更原则化的域适应，以及整合基础模型进行表示学习。

abstract: Patient-facing medical question answering with large language models (LLMs) is moving from research demonstrations to production deployments, yet evaluation remains anchored on factual correctness. Factuality is necessary but not sufficient: a response can be factually grounded and still issue a directive that, if acted on, would harm the patient. We introduce a risk-sensitive evaluation framework that scores responses by the presence and severity of six categories of risk-bearing language (treatment directives, contraindications, dosage expressions, urgency-triage cues, high-alert medication mentions, and overconfident assertions), anchored on published clinical harm taxonomies. Severity is classified by a three-judge LLM ensemble. abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Marmara University; conditions: Dental Caries, Caries Risk, Dental Plaque; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 250; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to develop and evaluate an artificial intelligence (AI)-based system that can detect dental caries and dental plaque in children using intraoral digital scans and photographs, and use these findings to estimate each child's risk of developing dental caries. Children aged 4-13 years who attend Marmara University Faculty of Dentistry, Department of Pediatric Dentistry for routine dental care will be invited to participate. Participants will receive a clinical dental examination. Dental caries will be evaluated using standard clinical criteria, and dental plaque will be assessed using a plaque index. Intraoral photographs and three-dimensional digital scans of the teeth will also be obtained. Parents will complete a questionnaire about their child's toothbrushing habits, sugar consumption, fluoride use, dental visits, and selected sociodemographic factors. The collected digital images and scans will be used to train and test an AI model designed to automatically identify and measure areas of dental caries and plaque. The AI findings will then be combined with clinical examination results and oral health-related information to classify children as having low, moderate, or high caries risk. Based on the assigned caries risk level, individualized preventive recommendations such as oral hygiene instruction, dietary counseling, fluoride applications, professional plaque control, and follow-up visits will be provided. Participants will be followed according to their risk level and digital scans and clinical assessments will be repeated to evaluate changes in caries, plaque, and caries risk over time. The study is expected to provide information on whether AI-assisted digital imaging can support more objective, standardized and personalized caries risk assessment and preventive dental care in children.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Marmara University；疾病/状况：龋齿、龋齿风险、牙菌斑；类型：观察性研究；入组人数：250；状态：尚未招募] 本研究旨在开发并评估一种基于人工智能（AI）的系统，该系统可利用口内数字扫描和照片检测儿童龋齿和牙菌斑，并利用这些发现估计每名儿童发生龋齿的风险。将邀请在Marmara University牙学院儿童牙科系接受常规牙科诊疗的4-13岁儿童参与。参与者将接受临床牙科检查。龋齿将使用标准临床标准进行评估，牙菌斑将使用菌斑指数进行评估。还将获取口内照片和牙齿三维数字扫描。家长将填写一份关于其子女刷牙习惯、糖摄入、氟化物使用、牙科就诊以及选定社会人口学因素的问卷。所收集的数字图像和扫描将用于训练和测试一个AI模型，该模型旨在自动识别和测量龋齿和牙菌斑区域。随后，AI发现将与临床检查结果和口腔健康相关信息相结合，将儿童分类为低、中或高龋齿风险。根据所分配的龋齿风险水平，将提供个体化预防建议，如口腔卫生指导、饮食咨询、氟化物应用、专业菌斑控制和随访就诊。参与者将根据其风险水平接受随访，并将重复数字扫描和临床评估，以评价龋齿、牙菌斑和龋齿风险随时间的变化。该研究预期将提供信息，说明AI辅助数字成像是否能够支持儿童更客观、标准化和个体化的龋齿风险评估及预防性牙科照护。
